clue.text: Disturbed sadist surrounded by drugs somewhere in Manhattan

indicators.note: the shuffled letters sit between the two letters that stand for the drugs

parts.note: E is slang for ecstasy, so two doses of the drug give E and E

indicators.note: disturbed letters are thrown into disorder, so sadist is rearranged

explanation.surface: A deranged sadist ends up surrounded by narcotics in a New York neighbourhood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disturbed sadist' reads as a description of a villain, but 'Disturbed' is the anagram signal; 'drugs' gives two Es, plural doses of ecstasy, which 'surrounded by' places on either side.
explanation.definitionFit: The East Side is a district of Manhattan, an example of a place there.

clue.text: Avoid regularly tense head

explanation.definitionFit: To escape something is to avoid or get away from it.

clue.text: Place in frame to display prominently

Pl is the abbreviation for place in addresses

explanation.definitionFit: To splash something, as a newspaper does with a story, is to show it prominently.

clue.text: Bird getting leg up in South East

indicators.note: the reversed leg word sits inside the compass abbreviation

parts.note: SE is the abbreviation for south-east

explanation.definitionFit: The snipe is a wading bird with a long straight bill.

clue.text: Exalt if dinghy is wrecked having lost front of hull

clue.text: Trail commercial during performance

clue.text: Frightful child read full-length extract

indicators.note: an extract is a passage taken from a longer text, here a run of letters

clue.text: Direction to get charge right for traveller

explanation.surface: Instructions on getting a traveller charged the correct amount.
explanation.definitionFit: A wayfarer is someone who travels on foot, a traveller.

clue.text: Careers about with head of little fish

explanation.definitionFit: Callings are vocations, the lines of work people pursue as careers.

clue.text: Fresh beer brewed by two unknowns

clue.text: Storage unit in tomb many don't use finally

parts.note: aid is help

clue.text: Quietly put down toy

parts.note: p is piano, the musical direction for quiet
to lay something is to put it down

explanation.surface: A child is told to set down a toy without making noise.
explanation.definitionFit: To toy with something is to play with it idly, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Weather conditions providing illumination around the beginning of night

indicators.note: the lighting word goes around the single letter

parts.note: lighting is illumination

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its opening letter

clue.text: Long period of time certain to result in obliteration

sis, short for sister, is a relative

clue.text: Nothing rises in ooze that's thinner than usual

clue.text: Everything, say, European dictator initially claimed

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of the word

clue.text: River in Dutch painting

parts.note: painting is art

explanation.surface: A river appears in a Dutch landscape painting.
explanation.walkthrough: The Dart is a river in Devon, in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dart is a river in Devon, an example of a river.

clue.text: Men used to brag

clue.text: Charlie, on one occasion, exercises theory

PT is physical training, exercises

clue.text: Simple citrus concoction

explanation.surface: A plain drink mixed from citrus fruit.

clue.text: Very large game bird

parts.note: OS is the abbreviation for outsize, very large in clothing sizes
game animals are hunted, as prey is

explanation.surface: A very large game bird.

clue.text: Arrive with time to see one pulling 29?

parts.note: to come is to arrive

clue.text: Little cars surprisingly outran bus

indicators.note: the letters end up in a surprising new order

clue.text: Burn bottom off jacket

indicators.note: in a down entry the bottom is the last letter, which is removed

parts.note: a blazer is a type of jacket

explanation.surface: A jacket burns and its bottom comes off.
explanation.definitionFit: To blaze is to burn fiercely with bright flames.

clue.text: Tears back to get vermouth and gin perhaps?

parts.note: rips are tears
It is short for Italian vermouth, as in the cocktail gin and it

explanation.surface: Someone crying while ordering a vermouth and gin.

clue.text: Hesitation after famous Geordie duo swap places with bottle

parts.note: to slay is to murder

explanation.definitionFit: A sleigh is a sledge drawn by horses or reindeer over snow, a vehicle.

clue.text: Way to gag Yankee with elastic
